definitions.explanation: The individual stitch or the overall pattern of loops in knitting, crochet, or weaving. Also used more broadly for any mesh or interlocking pattern.

examples.japanese: {編|あ}み{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦セーター→セーター：01371_seetaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{編|あ}み{目|め}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧だ。
examples.english: This sweater has a really pretty knitted pattern.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{編|あ}む→編む：00002_amu⟧ (to knit, weave) + ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (eye, mesh). Refers both to the individual stitch and to the overall pattern of stitches.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {編|あ}み{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧: tight, fine stitches
- {編|あ}み{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{粗|あら}い→粗い：00439_arai⟧: loose, coarse stitches
- {編|あ}み{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そろえる: to keep the stitches even
- {編|あ}み{目|め}⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧: knit pattern
- {編|あ}み{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{数|かぞ}える→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧: to count the stitches

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{網目|あみめ}→網目：08144_amime⟧: mesh; net pattern — same reading; refers to net or grid patterns, not specifically knitting
- ステッチ: stitch — broader, includes sewing
- ⟦{編|あ}み→編む：00002_amu⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧: knitting method — the technique rather than the result
